source.check: returned unopposed (Londonderry Sentinel, 7 January 1926, p4: eight aldermen returned unopposed, West Ward J. Turner and P. Meenan, Labour); full names from its nominations list (p2)

note: Election of the whole Londonderry Corporation (six councillors and two aldermen for each of the five wards), poll Friday 15 January 1926. The Labour Party, with Nationalist support, contested all five wards; the Journal gives the new Corporation as 16 Labour and 24 Unionist (Derry Journal, 18 January 1926). The Unionist aldermen for East, North and Waterside were returned unopposed and the South aldermanships were contested. Returned unopposed.
